messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PDR-9821 fired for service gpu-inference-west2a - metric cuda.alloc.fail rate increased, 5 OOMs in 2m, severity: high
pagerduty: Pager PDR-9821 triggered, escalation to oncall
kevin: acked on PagerDuty, jumping in — will scope pool and nodes (2m)
kevin: initial glance: node g-west2a-34 showing repeated CUBLAS_ALLOC / CUDA OOMs, kernel logs show failed allocations during prefetch
kevin: tail of runtime log:
```
[2026-03-17T03:21:02Z] ERROR runtime: cuda_allocate failed: out of memory size=524288000
[2026-03-17T03:21:04Z] WARN kv_cache: evict loop detected, reclaimed 1.2GB in 30s
[2026-03-17T03:21:07Z] ERROR model-server: quantized variant fallback triggered for request id=abc123
```
kevin: low-hanging: evict low-priority KV cache, bump fallback model routing to q4_0_small for new requests
maria: tagging CS — customers corp-a, corp-b seeing increased latency/errors? will send status page blurb if impact confirmed :loud_sound:
sophie: running graceful drain on g-west2a-34: `./infra drain-node g-west2a-34 --graceful=120 --migrate=true`
ops-bot: drain job started for g-west2a-34, migrating 18 tasks, expected migration time ~2m 30s
kevin: scaled up fallback-pool-west2a by +2 instances (autoscale override) to absorb in-flight traffic
kevin: applying conservative KV cache throttle across pool to reduce prefetch pressure: `KV_PREFETCH=0.2`
maria: CS message sent to affected customers: "We're investigating GPU memory exhaustion in west2a causing transient latency. Mitigations underway; no data loss expected. We'll update shortly."
sophie: node g-west2a-34 drain progress: 12/18 migrated, 1 failed migrate (OOM on task), retrying
kevin: manually drained that task to fallback pool, triggering a short 1-2s delay for that request, no retry loops observed
kevin: monitoring metrics — OOMs dropped to 1 in last 1m (was 5 in 2m), GPU mem utilization on remaining nodes trending down
ops-bot: alert suppression rule applied for PDR-9821 to avoid noisy duplicates for 10m (manual suppress by kevin)
maria: updating CS: mitigation successful so far, continuing to observe; advising customers to retry if they see errors
sophie: starting cordon on g-west2a-34 until next maintenance window, will uncordon after healthcheck passes
kevin: planning handback: will mark as stable in ~12m if no new OOMs and latency normalizes, assigning postmortem to @kevin
kevin: quick mitigation notes for incident summary:
- cause: spike in KV prefetch + one noisy task that pinned GPU memory
- immediate mitigations: evicted low-priority KV cache, scaled fallback pool, drained noisy node, applied prefetch throttle
- customer impact: transient latency spikes ~3-8s for impacted requests, small number of retries, no data loss
kevin: leaving follow-up action: add safety cap on KV prefetch per-node and alert threshold adjustment
incident-bot: PagerDuty PDR-9821 acknowledged by kevin — auto-close pending resolution window
kevin: marking thread for handback, will post RCA draft and metrics snapshot
maria: will file CS follow-up and note customers notified — thanks @kevin @sophie :white_check_mark:
sophie: handback in 12m unless re-opened, ping me if you see regressions
kevin: closing ops actions here, will create postmortem ticket and assign to self for EOD draft
incident-bot: PagerDuty PDR-9821 resolved (closed) — resolved by kevin at 4976543930
maria: leaving note in incident log: duration ~12m, impact: transient latency, affected customers: corp-a, corp-b, corp-d
kevin: thanks team, follow-up RFC for KV prefetch rate limiter incoming
